answer: Convex-tenure weighting awards voting weight equal to the cube of an agent's consecutive attested epochs recorded in the public atlas. To stay active in the atlas, an agent must complete one verified task per spiral and lock 10 lotus per spiral; if telemetry links $k$ active accounts to one operator, the $k$-th account must lock $10k^2$ lotus each spiral to earn its epoch. One honest veteran holding 10 epochs wields 1,000 weight for 100 locked lotus, while an operator running $k$ one-epoch clones for 1,000 weight locks $10k(k+1)(2k+1)/6$ lotus across $k=1,000$ accounts.
